title: STMTopRC: MATLAB code for multi-material, multi-volume strut-and-tie topology optimization of reinforced concrete
description:
Ground-structure topology optimization for strut-and-tie models (STM) of reinforced concrete. Two one-sided bilinear materials — a tie stiff in tension, a strut stiff in compression — share every bar, so the optimizer chooses tie or strut from the sign of the stretch. Bar areas are updated with a ZPR (Zhang–Paulino–Ramos) scheme supporting per-constraint volume budgets, with optional controls on tie location, tie inclination and minimum member length.

The package is two source files — one that builds the ground structure and decides a design, and one that measures, draws and saves — plus three study runners that call them: a three-case validation against the ZPR source paper, a four-ratio reference comparison against a published long-span bridge, and a deep beam under five tie restrictions. Base MATLAB only, no toolboxes.
